[SWS_TcpIp_00142] ⌈The TcpIp shall call Up_PhysAddrTableChg() directly after
each ARP table change:
• If TcpIp adds a new entry or updates an existing one, the parameter valid shall
be set to TRUE and the parameters IpAddrPtr and PhysAddrPtr shall be set ac-
cording to the new or updated entry.
• In case TcpIp removes an entry, valid shall be set to FALSE and the parameters
IpAddrPtr and PhysAddrPtr shall be set according to the removed entry.
⌋
